groups.name: Consumables
groups.description: Food, drink, and other items consumed for effects (hunger/thirst/stamina).
notes: Pairs with hunger, thirst, and status systems
Typical stack_max: 10 for food, 5 for strong alcohol

groups.name: Materials
groups.description: Crafting inputs and processing goods used by crafting/cooking scripts.
notes: Keep recipe references separate from the item list
Often dropped by hunting, gathering, mining jobs

groups.name: Trade Goods
groups.description: Items bought, sold, or delivered through shops, wagon missions, and trade runs.
notes: Useful for economy and delivery jobs
Common in VORP/RSG shops with shop table configs

groups.name: Quest Items
groups.description: Items meant for one-time mission or progression logic; usually non-droppable, non-tradable.
notes: Avoid mixing these with normal inventory utilities
Set stack_max=1 and unique=true where supported

groups.name: Documents
groups.description: Notes, papers, maps, cards, and other readable/collectible items.
notes: Often used for clues, missions, and lore
Some (cigarette cards, newspaper) are collectible sets

groups.name: Weapon Components / Ammo
groups.description: Ammunition stacks and weapon attachments/skins used by weapon scripts.
notes: Ammo types match AMMO_* native constants
Component slugs match weapon_component_hashes in native docs

groups.name: Clothing / Apparel
groups.description: Wearable items sold by tailors/barbers or given as quest rewards.
notes: Stored in wardrobe tables vorp_clothing / rsg_clothing
Each item maps to a drawable+texture or component hash pair

groups.name: Medical / Aid
groups.description: Revive items, bandages, tonics, snake-oil used by doctor/healer jobs.
notes: Typically consumed on use; triggers revive/heal exports
Used with ns-lib:UseItem or framework AddUseItem
